package fixture

// The fixed fixture: the same four refusals, each now saying what to do, beside
// the four shapes that always did. The scanner must find nothing here at all.

import (
	"fmt"
	"io"
)

func cmdBare(stderr io.Writer, bench string) int {
	fmt.Fprintf(stderr, "FILL REFUSED bench=%s is not a card bench (run: nova-pulse fleet registry --machines queue/control/machines.tsv to name one)\n", bench)
	return 2
}

func cmdColon(stderr io.Writer, path string) int {
	fmt.Fprintf(stderr, "REFUSED: the lanes file %s has no lane of that name; run: nova-pulse lanes --file %s\n", path, path)
	return 2
}

func cmdReason(stderr io.Writer, why string) int {
	fmt.Fprintf(stderr, "PROBE REFUSED reason=%s the volume was already open (close it, then probe again)\n", why)
	return 2
}

// The noun bracket is gone: the trouble is prose and the bracket is the answer.
func cmdNounBracket(stderr io.Writer, lane string) int {
	fmt.Fprintf(stderr, "GATE REFUSED lane=%s the queue is held (run: nova-merge hold --lane %s --release)\n", lane, lane)
	return 2
}

// The four shapes that pass.

func okRemedyField(stderr io.Writer, bench string) int {
	fmt.Fprintf(stderr, "FILL REFUSED bench=%s reason=runner-host remedy=%q\n", bench, "name a bench")
	return 2
}

func okParenImperative(stderr io.Writer, slot string) int {
	fmt.Fprintf(stderr, "DELETE-SLOT REFUSED: %s still holds jobs (delete its jobs first)\n", slot)
	return 2
}

func okRunTail(stderr io.Writer, repo string) int {
	fmt.Fprintf(stderr, "SWEEP REFUSED: %s is behind; run: nova-merge sweep --repo %s --once\n", repo, repo)
	return 2
}

func okPassThrough(stderr io.Writer, err error) int {
	fmt.Fprintf(stderr, "SEND REFUSED: %s\n", err)
	return 2
}
